scope: One eligible-candidate counting fix; one bounded real build-verification task, not a natural-task benchmark.

source.state: Candidate-count fix plus focused regressions and regenerated runtime, before the delivery commit.

commands.privateRunner: The task-specific runner and original command logs remain local under ignored .artifacts; they are not part of the published package.

setupAttempt.cause: The official headless template disables credentials. The first test overlay set a path without enabling the row.
setupAttempt.correction: Enable the native credentials row in the isolated overlay; use a new evidence directory.

limitations: The build-verification fixture performs real module imports, file copies and checksum validation. It is a controlled single task, not a natural-task success-rate or performance benchmark.

All 24 choices selected omit with probabilities 0.58-0.67. The existing 0.8 threshold rejected every omission; the final persisted tool text equals the original. This live run does not demonstrate log reduction or original-log recovery after omission.

Both passive DeepSeek SSE clones ended with AbortError while observing response metadata. The native task completed with exit 0 and no agent errors; this is incomplete passive stream observation, not a product stream failure or a complete DeepSeek wire capture.
The Jev request body and complete response were retained privately and compared with the business ledger; HTTP 200 alone was not used as task success evidence.
Raw profiles, Session logs, provider packets, credentials and authenticated Web details are excluded from public files. The run did not change an existing user profile.
